types.text: Original description, requirements or annotation text with its source reference.
types.dimensions: Explicit named dimension values, units, geometric associations and evidence status.
types.raster-sketch: Rasterized sketch or orthographic drawing with source pixels and view identity.
types.raster-plan: Rasterized building/floor plan with scale/orientation controls and source pixels.
types.vector-drawing: DXF/SVG or equivalent planar curves/entities with units, layers, transforms and provenance.
types.photo-set: One or more source images with capture or generation provenance and image identity.
types.video: Source video with time/frame metadata and capture provenance.
types.depth-frames: Depth or RGB-D observations with sensor calibration, units, timestamps and frame identity.
types.point-cloud: Sampled spatial points with declared frame/scale and retained observation/registration evidence.
types.mesh: Polygon surface geometry with units, frame, intended role and generation lineage.
types.gaussian-scene: Gaussian scene parameters and associated cameras, units/scale evidence and training/export lineage.
types.nerf-scene: Neural radiance-field model/checkpoint with camera/data lineage and rendering configuration.
types.measurement-set: Typed evidence values or calculated transform/fit/anchor records; each value carries units, frame, source and status.
types.camera-solution: Camera intrinsics, distortion and/or poses with explicit conventions and estimation/calibration provenance.
types.model-brief: Structured geometry intent: parts, dimensions, units, datums, evidence, interpretation and intended outputs.
types.constrained-sketch: Sketch geometry plus explicit geometric/dimensional constraints and source associations.
types.parametric-source: Editable program or native parametric construction source retaining its controlling parameters.
types.cad-solid: Boundary-representation solid geometry with topology, analytic/spline/faceted surface status and provenance.
types.cad-assembly: Named component occurrences with placement transforms and retained source identities.
types.ifc: IFC model graph with building entities, relationships, placements and represented geometry.
types.robot-assembly: Named rigid bodies/links, joints, frames and associations to component and physical-property records.
types.mjcf: MuJoCo model source with referenced assets, bodies, joints, contacts and recorded physical inputs.
types.urdf: Robot-description tree with link/joint and visual/collision/inertial data and referenced assets.
types.visual-scene: Display/render scene with objects, cameras, materials and representation-specific content.
types.fabrication-package: Source-linked requested manufacturing derivatives, dimensions and stated material/process information.
types.source-library: Identified source collection or selected source assets with original links, item identities and rights records.
types.native-model-document: Editable model/drawing document in its owning tool; its feature-history capability is separately recorded.
types.verification-report: Checks, measured values, statuses and hashes tied to the exact artifact/revision checked.
types.registration-transform: Estimated mapping between named source/target frames with units, correspondence evidence and residuals.
types.step-file: Actual STEP exchange artifact; representation and identity preservation depend on the exporter/importer and checks.
